% !tp-example Basic usage
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcTpBox{
  The query lists three European capitals. Expand the query in the result panel to see its rows.

  \wcTpSqlViewer[src=/docs/components/_shared/intro-projects/sql.json]{}
}
\end{document}

% !tp-example Javascript API
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcScript[type=module]|
import "/components/box/box.js";
import "/components/sql-viewer/sql-viewer.js";

const example = document.createDocumentFragment();

const element1 = document.createElement("tp-box");
element1.append(document.createTextNode("\n  "));

const element2 = document.createElement("p");
element2.append(document.createTextNode("The query lists three European capitals. Expand the query in the result panel to see its rows."));
element1.append(element2);
element1.append(document.createTextNode("\n  "));

const element3 = document.createElement("tp-sql-viewer");
element3.setAttribute("src", "/docs/components/_shared/intro-projects/sql.json");
element1.append(element3);
element1.append(document.createTextNode("\n"));
example.append(element1);

document.body.append(example);
|
\end{document}

% !tp-example src
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcTpSqlViewer[src=/docs/components/sql-viewer/examples/example.json]{}
\end{document}

% !tp-example script without filename
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcTpSqlViewer{
  \wcScript[type=tp/sql]|
        CREATE TABLE users (name TEXT NOT NULL);
        INSERT INTO users (name) VALUES ('Ada'), ('Grace');
      |
}
\end{document}

% !tp-example scripts with filename
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcTpSqlViewer{
  \wcScript[type=tp/sql,filename=tables.sql]|
        CREATE TABLE users (name TEXT NOT NULL);
        INSERT INTO users (name) VALUES ('Ada'), ('Grace');
      |
  \wcScript[type=tp/sql,filename=query.sql]|
        SELECT name
        FROM users
        ORDER BY name;
      |
}
\end{document}

% !tp-example error
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcTpSqlViewer{
  \wcScript[type=tp/sql,filename=query.sql]|
        SELECT * FROM missing_table;
      |
}
\end{document}

% !tp-example Single source file
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcTpSqlViewer[src=/docs/components/_shared/single-source/example.sql]{}
\end{document}
